data.body: **[P2] Approach: supply the required design rationale for the new harness.** This adds a separate environment, deployment workflow, cloud driver, and instrumentation, but the PR description gives implementation changes and validation without the design note required by rule 3 or the simpler alternatives required by rule 2. Policy decisions such as the five-second cleanup grace and rejection of whole-environment replacement are also absent from the description's decision record required by rule 7. Return to the design phase under rule 8, step 6: document the problem, cause, alternatives, chosen approach, removals, and policy decisions, and obtain maintainer agreement before continuing implementation.
